ruling: RUL-2026-10-12-006 (Katana, Crystal) and RUL-2026-10-12-008 (Reliquary, Filament, Skyglass Serum): the director supplies every value below; Fable slots it in and validates. Nothing here is drafted on the director's behalf.
consumer: push/90_ghost_ship_skyglass_release.gen.py. A null value keeps the manifest in DRAFT mode with a labelled placeholder; --final refuses while any value is null.

skyglass_katana.description: A Crystal-edged sword borne by the Captain's most faithful reconstruction. Its command seals resist interference, turning a measure of the wielder's damage into a brief protective lattice.
skyglass_katana.battleDescription: %user cuts with the Skyglass Katana as pale command seals awaken along its Crystal edge.

skyglass_crystal.description: A shard of Skyglass worked to carry the ship's protective lattice into another weapon. When its seals awaken, part of the wielder's damage returns as a brief shield.
skyglass_crystal.battleDescription: Pale seal-light traces %user's weapon as the Skyglass Crystal's dormant pattern awakens.

skyglass_reliquary.description: A black-iron coffer recovered from the Ghost Ship's quarantined archive. Its heavy clasps preserve what the Sealwright kept apart from the vessel's ceaseless work of reconstruction.
skyglass_reliquary.battleDescription: The Skyglass Reliquary opens beneath %user's hand, its pale lock going dark at last.

skyglass_filament.description: A hair-thin strand from the seal lattice that keeps the Ghost Ship aloft. Even separated from the hull, it retains enough structure to be woven into a weapon-bound Skyglass Crystal.
skyglass_filament.battleDescription: The Skyglass Filament trembles with a pale pulse of seal-light.

skyglass_serum.description: A concentrated restorative sealed for the Ghost Ship's longest chakra operations. The medicine remains potent, though the living crew it was prepared to sustain has long since vanished.
skyglass_serum.battleDescription: %user drinks the Skyglass Serum as pale seal-light closes their wounds.

effectPresentationShape: Optional. Either null (keep the record's empty animation/SFX fields) or an object with any of appearAnimation, staticAnimation, disappearAnimation, appearSfx, disappearSfx, staticAssetPath, applied to every effect tag of that item.
